exposure: high blood pressure in previous pregnancies
cohort: 552 patients with hypertensive disorders in pregnancy at Gynae A ward, Qazi Hussain Ahmed Medical Complex, Nowshera, between January 1, 2019, and December 31, 2019.
finding: The prevalence of hypertensive disorders in pregnancy was 13.9%, with pregnancy-induced hypertension being the most frequent (57.97%), and lack of antenatal booking being the most common risk factor (61%).
mod_finding: 56.5% of patients had vaginal delivery, 4.5% had instrumental delivery, and 39% had a cesarean section.
